remarks: Bring your vision to 79 Loughran Ave, a once in a lifetime, out of the flood zone waterfront property located in the Mid-Ridges of Stamford. This home recently suffered an interior fire, and was subsequently taken down to the studs. Per the city tax card this home is a 4 bedroom, 3 bath ranch, with a 1,576 sq. ft. footprint + 525 sq ft attached garage. Additionally, there is a full walk-out lower level with 10' +/- ceilings. The opportunities are endless - rebuild the existing ranch and capture 2500+ sq ft of finished area (between first and lower level) or vertically expand and build up. Currently on septic/ well, however city sewer and public water are available in the street for connection. Located just south of the Merritt Parkway, and just minutes from Whole Foods, restaurants, shopping and Downtown Stamford. This is a very rare opportunity to own waterfront home, elevated from the river & out of the AE flood zone, that is south of the parkway. Whether you are a builder looking for your next project or an end-user dreaming of a custom waterfront lifestyle, this "blank canvas" is not one to miss out on. This home is sold as-is, where is.
